scope: Fresh Firefox profile; real pinned tor-js bundle and worker through the existing local development KPS gateway with a temporary current-NIC address override. No mock or proxy bundle, execution RPC, consensus request, transaction, or public deployment.
gatewaySelection: Temporary active-NIC override; existing gateway port and public key retained; no environment changes
method: Start an isolated Vite page importing the production startAnonTransport and TOR_JS_PIN/withGateways.
Use the configured gateway port and public key with the currently active LAN address; do not modify environment files or existing services.
Record every browser HTTP(S) request whose origin differs from the isolated local Vite server.
Observe iframe creation after the harness completes bundle hash verification, then await transport.ready.
Close the transport, count remaining iframes, and assert a subsequent fetch is refused before it sends.

priorAttempt.configuration: Existing environment retained an address from the previous network; that address was absent from current interface addresses.

result.error: worker readiness exceeded 90000 ms live-test limit

priorAttempt.diagnosis: The unreachable selected gateway fell back to the hash-checked public bundle URL. The worker then failed to become ready through the stale gateway within the 90-second test deadline. A temporary address-only override produced the successful run above.

limitations: This validates one existing local development gateway, not a newly deployed or publicly reachable gateway.
Public bundle resolver fallbacks remain enabled and can contact a CDN if KPS acquisition fails; there is no direct RPC fallback.

Upstream KPS connection dialing has a deadline, but the harness bundle body has no explicit deadline or abort signal. Closing during initial bundle acquisition can still complete that acquisition later; this change does not patch that upstream lifecycle limitation.
No execution RPC, consensus proof, on-chain pin proof, or paid request was exercised in this isolated bundle-delivery check.
